remarks: Level fenced property attractively priced for updates/renovation in desirable Westport neighborhood featuring mix of historic and newer homes. Enclosed front porch. Hardwood floors throughout. Expanded kitchen. Private fenced garden and patio. Walk to town and award-winning library, downtown shopping, restaurants, Westport Country Playhouse, and Levitt Pavilion for summer concerts. Enjoy the town-owned golf course, marina, sailing school, and three LI Sound beaches. Property previously featured a noted sculpture garden. Sizeable separate heated two-car garage with workshop space. House is primed for renovation, expansion, or new build with town water and sewer. House being sold As Is at new lower price and is subject to probate approval.
